Iran Increases Attacks on Shipping Amid US War Threat

Iran is reportedly shifting tactics to increase attacks on shipping, with officials suggesting this is happening before the US vote. This comes as Iran fights a spike in militant attacks domestically, occurring as a US war threat looms. The specific nature of the shifting tactics and the exact timing of the attacks on shipping were not detailed.
